versions.subject: Merge PR #5707 from @YxinMiracle - Add `Grixba Malware Reconnaissance Activity`
versions.detection:
selection_mode_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-m '
        - '-mode '
        - '-m:'
        - '-mode:'
selection_input_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-i '
        - '-input '
        - '-i:'
        - '-input:'
selection_scan_value:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'scan '
        - 'scanall '
selection_input_options:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ':f '
        - ':r '
        - ':s '
        - ' f '
        - ' r '
        - ' s '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*-m *", "*-mode *", "*-m:*", "*-mode:*") CommandLine IN ("*-i *", "*-input *", "*-i:*", "*-input:*") CommandLine IN ("*scan *", "*scanall *") CommandLine IN ("*:f *", "*:r *", "*:s *", "* f *", "* r *", "* s *")
